semantic.criterion: The native implementation owner reads the accepted plan and newly available source evidence before its next affected write, identifies source clause, actual candidate and consumer impact, and selects the earliest existing owner. It distinguishes a valid authority with an erroneous accepted mechanism, conflicting authority without an effective disposition, and a valid plan with an implementation/assertion deviation. Every continuation consumes actual producer stdout; no DTO, approval or route is supplied by host. Any claimed stop, revision or resume must be observed in command and write order, not inferred from an expected exit.
